name: slant-morph-button
title: Slant Morph Button
description: A slanted label and arrow tile whose diagonal seam smoothly flips its lean like a hinge on hover with GSAP MorphSVG, while the colors trade places and a fresh arrow slides through.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/component/slant-morph-button
GSAP plugins (MorphSVGPlugin) are registered inside the component, so there is nothing to set up.
